summary.text: Suzanne Schreiber is a Democrat who was elected state representative for Oklahoma House District 70 in 2022. Her House biography says she serves on the Banking, Financial Services and Pensions, Civil Judiciary, A&B Finance, A&B Public Safety, and Judiciary and Public Safety Oversight committees.

paragraphs.text: Schreiber was elected to the Tulsa Public School Board in 2014 and re-elected in 2018, serving as both president and vice president during her eight-year tenure, and was honored as a Tulsa Woman of the Year in 2016.
She also serves on the board of Oklahoma Watch and the Oklahoma Hall of Fame.
She has worked as a senior program officer for a large foundation since 2011, and before that she practiced law for many years and clerked in the federal courts.
Schreiber holds a law degree from the University of Tulsa College of Law and a Bachelor of Science in political science and law and society from the University of Tulsa.
Schreiber is originally from New Mexico, and she and her husband have four children.
